name: Sciatica Drops
dosage:
In acute cases, take 8-10 drops of Dr. Reckeweg R71 in some water every ¼ to ½ hour
When improvement sets in, lower the dosage to 10-15 drops every 1-2 hours

Safety Information:

Do not exceed the recommended dosage
Read the label carefully before use
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight
Keep out of reach of children
Avoid any strong smell in the mouth, such as coffee, onion, hing
side_effects: No known side effects when taken as directed.
